data.name: Judicious Force
data.description: If you or an ally within 10 feet makes a critical threat with a melee or ranged attack, as an immediate action you may add +4 to the confirmation roll. This does not stack with the Critical Focus feat. You may use this ability %1 times per day.|DomainJusticeTimes
